name: Scale
definition: The size of an element in relation to the human body, to the space around it and to the other elements. A style chooses a reference body and holds the elements in a range around it.

sources.title: Julius Panero and Martin Zelnik, Human Dimension and Interior Space (Whitney Library of Design, 1979)
Ernst and Peter Neufert, Architects' Data (Wiley-Blackwell, 4th English edition, 2012)
